|1|col(+) 在子查询外,like 后为子查询语句，预期报错执行成功,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cfea1ad9a3311dc8e18/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|select * from test_ydbrd26125_table_01 t1,test_ydbrd26125_table_02 t2     
  where t1.c1(+) like (select c1 from test_ydbrd26125_table_02 t2 where     [t2.id](http://t2.id)     like '%2') order by     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,    [t2.id](http://t2.id)    ,t2.c1;|此子查询的校验逻辑沿用旧版本，与旧版本compare类型的Filter逻辑一致，可不处理；|
|2|select * from两个表,结果为啥会出现第三个表的数据?,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cfea1ad9a3311dc8e1a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|select     *     from   test_ydbrd26125_table_01 t1,test_ydbrd26125_table_02 t2   where   t1.c1(  +  )   like     '%4%'     order   by     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,    [t2.id](http://t2.id)    ,t2.c1;|建表语句中表3的数据误插入到表2中，非问题；|
|3|nvl两个参数都为null，结果报错    
  ifnull函数一样,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cfea1ad9a3311dc8e1b/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|select * from test_ydbrd26125_table_01 t1,test_ydbrd26125_table_02 t2     
  where nvl(null,null) not like t1.c2(+)||'%' order by     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,    [t2.id](http://t2.id)    ,t2.c1;    
  select * from test_ydbrd26125_table_01 t1,test_ydbrd26125_table_02 t2 where ifnull(null,null) not like t1.c2(+)||'%' order by     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,    [t2.id](http://t2.id)    ,t2.c1;|全常量入参的内置函数会被提前执行，即nvl  (  null  ,   null  )和  ifnull  (  null  ,   null  )都会被提前执行为NULL，然后NULL参与到LIKE等谓词又会被提前执行为FILTER_TRUE，FILTER_FALSE，此次需求规格不涉及静态优化场景；|

|10|在plsql中使用报错    
,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cfe8970c2af4f520fb0/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|-- if condition    
  declare    
      a1   int   :  =     11  ;    
      a2   int   :  =     112  ;    
  begin    
        if   a1   like   a2(  +  )  ||  '%'     then    
          DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'a1 like a2'  );    
        elsif   a1   not     like   a2(  +  )  ||  '%'     then    
          DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'a1 not like a2'  );    
        else    
          DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'other condition'  );    
        end     if  ;    
  end  ;    
  /,  
  -- case condition    
  declare    
      a1   int   :  =     1  ;    
      a2   int   :  =     2  ;    
  begin    
        case   a1   like     nvl  (a2(  +  ),  null  )  ||  '%'    
            when     true     then   DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'a1 like a2'  );    
            when     false     then    
          DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'a1 not like a2'  );    
        end     case  ;    
  end  ;    
  /    
    
  CREATE     OR     REPLACE     PROCEDURE   ydbrd26125_proc(a1   int  ,a2   int  )   IS    
  BEGIN    
        CASE     WHEN   a1   like   a2(  +  )  ||  '%'     and   a2   in   (  121  ,  122  ,  123  )   THEN    
          DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'a1 like a2'  );    
        WHEN   a1(  +  )   not     like   a2  ||  '%'     THEN    
          DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(  'a1 not like a2'  );    
        END     CASE  ;    
  END  ;    
  /    
  exec   ydbrd26125_proc(  11  ,  123  );    
  exec   ydbrd26125_proc(  2  ,  121  );    
  drop     PROCEDURE   ydbrd26125_proc;

          a1 :  =   a1   +     1  ;    
            end     loop  ;    
  end  ;

,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cff8970c2af4f520fb3/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|select * from test_ydbrd26125_table_01 t1 , test_ydbrd26125_table_02 t2 start with t1.c1 like t2.c1(+) connect by     [t1.id](http://t1.id)     = 5 order by     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,    [t2.id](http://t2.id)    ,t2.c1;

|14|merge into，(+)在on condition 中，不支持？,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cff8970c2af4f520fb5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|

  insert into test_ydbrd26125_table_15_2 values (2,2);    
  commit ;,-- 在on condition 中

  using test_ydbrd26125_table_15_2 t2

|15|在update、delete的where中使用(+)，不支持？,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396cffa1ad9a3311dc8e24/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._1E2EFLob3Q0uhrneLCS_0qBUWTaA7r8y-m4_aN_WHQ)|create table test_ydbrd26125_table_15_3(id int, c1 int, c2 int, c3 int);

  update   test_ydbrd26125_table_15_3 t3   set   c1   =     3     where   t3.c1(  +  )   is     null  ;    
  update   test_ydbrd26125_table_15_3 t3   set   c2   =     4     where   t3.c2(  +  )   in   (  -  1  ,  -  2  ,  -  3  );,
